camp.name: FOOTYUP Miami College Combine 2027 — Belen Jesuit Preparatory School

event.name: FOOTYUP x GOINGFORGOAT College Combine
event.location: Belen Jesuit Preparatory School, 500 SW 127th Ave, Miami, FL
event.infoText:
Players will participate in an elite three-day college soccer combine designed to provide exposure to college coaches, professional athletic performance testing, and high-level competition.

The combine will feature approximately 20–30 college programs attending each of the boys' and girls' events.

Every registered player will receive an exclusive GOINGFORGOAT x FOOTYUP package, shipped directly to their home before the combine, including combine kits and additional player gear.

Athletes take part in competitive training sessions, small-sided games, full-field matches, and advanced athletic performance testing using VALD technology.
